subjects.description: A flatbed truck traveling ahead in the same lane as the ego vehicle, its rear deck loaded with a cluster of deactivated traffic signal heads strapped upright as cargo

subjects.relationship: The vehicle directly ahead that the ego car is following and reacting to
subjects.location: center of frame, occupying the mid-ground of the lane
subjects.orientation: rear of the truck facing the camera, moving away in the same direction
subjects.action: Driving forward along the highway lane carrying the signal-head cargo
subjects.state_changes: Slows slightly as the ego vehicle brakes behind it, maintaining a steady gap otherwise

subjects.description: A cluster of deactivated traffic signal heads strapped upright as cargo on the flatbed
subjects.appearance_details: Standard three-lens signal housings with red lens on top, amber in the middle, and green at the bottom; all lenses are dark glass with no illumination; some housings still bear visors and mounting brackets; matte black powder-coated shells with faded reflective backing
subjects.relationship: The cargo carried by the flatbed truck that the ego vehicle misreads as live signals
subjects.location: upper-center of frame atop the truck bed
subjects.orientation: lenses facing rearward toward the ego vehicle
subjects.action: Remaining completely dark and static; no lamp ever illuminates
subjects.state_changes: No significant change; lamps stay unlit throughout.

background_setting: A multi-lane divided highway on a clear, sunny day. A central median with a metal guardrail and low vegetation separates the opposing carriageways. The asphalt is smooth and dry with crisp white lane markings. Distant hills and a bright blue sky with a few thin clouds line the horizon. Sparse traffic flows normally in adjacent lanes, and the road directly ahead is open and clear beyond the truck.

aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Calm, routine driving turned briefly tense and hesitant
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating white dashed lane markings and the vertical repetition of stacked traffic signal lenses

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking shot from the ego vehicle's dashcam perspective, following the truck; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame

cinematography.focus: Sharp focus on the flatbed truck and its cargo, with the road and horizon also crisp

context: Autonomous driving perception edge-case: misclassification of dark traffic signal heads carried as cargo as active live signals

The ego vehicle registers the dark signal heads as live lights and brakes hesitantly, slowing sharply. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The ego vehicle continues crawling at the reduced speed behind the truck while the road ahead remains clear. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam view shows the ego car cruising smoothly on a clear, sunlit divided highway directly behind a white flatbed truck carrying a cluster of upright, strapped traffic signal heads whose red, amber, and green lenses are all dark. By 0:01 the ego vehicle's perception mistakes the unlit signal heads for live lights, and it begins braking hesitantly, decelerating sharply and pitching forward slightly as the gap to the truck widens. From 0:03 through 0:05 the ego vehicle keeps crawling at the reduced speed behind the truck; the road ahead remains completely clear and the signal lenses never illuminate, holding the hesitant slow-down for the final stretch. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Ambient road noise dominates: steady tire hum on smooth asphalt, wind rushing past the windshield, and the low drone of the ego engine. Around 0:01 a subtle deceleration cue is heard as engine pitch drops and a faint brake application shifts the tone, followed by the quieter hum of crawling speed through the final seconds. No speech or music.
